reviews.text: I'm a gluthatione fan so I had to try this one. I think my skin is clearer whenever I consume gluthatione. The product lives up to my expectations and helps my skin stay clear and bright. I have to say all the drama about the taste is either a boycott or written by people who never consume 0% sugar stuff...as the taste of the product is citrus+strong stevia. If you don't like the taste of sweeteners, you won't like this. If you're okay with like a 30sec sweetener taste in your mouth, you won't have an issue.
reviews.zh: 我係穀胱甘肽嘅粉絲，所以一定要試吓呢款。我覺得每次食穀胱甘肽，我嘅皮膚都會更清透。產品符合我嘅期望，幫我嘅皮膚保持清透同亮白。我要講，有關味道嘅所有爭議，唔係杯葛，就係由啲從來唔食 0% 糖嘢嘅人寫嘅……因為產品嘅味道係柑橘加上濃烈嘅甜菊。如果你唔鍾意甜味劑嘅味道，你就唔會鍾意呢款。如果你可以接受口中有大約 30 秒嘅甜味劑味道，就冇問題。

reviews.text:
I’ve been using this Vitamin Village Liposome Glutathione Film for about 5 to 6 months now, and I am already on my 6th box! I am genuinely so impressed with the results. It has a very pleasant taste, making it super easy to stay consistent.
​Since adding it to my daily routine, I’ve noticed a significant improvement in fading my post-acne dark spots and hyperpigmentation. My overall skin texture also looks much smoother and more even. It really brightens your skin from within. Will definitely keep repurchasing!
reviews.zh:
我用咗呢款 Vitamin Village Liposome Glutathione Film 大約 5 至 6 個月，而家已經係第六盒！我對效果真係好滿意。味道好好，所以好容易堅持食。
自從加入我嘅日常護理，我留意到暗瘡後嘅暗啞同色素沉澱淡咗好多。我嘅整體皮膚質地都變得更加滑、更均勻。佢真係由內而外提亮皮膚。一定會繼續回購！

reviews.text:
I was really curious to try these because I had never used glutathione in this format before. The little films are individually packed, which makes them super convenient to carry around or take when travelling. They’re easy to use and I actually prefer this to taking another pill every day 😄
It’s obviously too early for me to judge any long-term effects from glutathione, but so far I really like the format and will keep using them. The box contains 30 individually packed films, so it’s also very easy to keep track of them.
reviews.zh:
我好想試吓呢款，因為我之前未試過呢種形式嘅穀胱甘肽。小膜片係獨立包裝，所以攜帶或者旅行時帶住都好方便。好易用，我其實比較鍾意呢種形式，唔使每日都食粒藥丸 😄
我當然仲未可以判斷穀胱甘肽嘅長期效果，不過到目前為止，我好鍾意呢種形式，會繼續用。一盒有 30 片獨立包裝嘅膜片，所以都好容易記錄食咗幾多。

reviews.text:
I really like these glutathione strips! They are so convenient and easy to use, especially compared to traditional tablets or capsules. They dissolve quickly and have a pleasant taste, making them very easy to include in my daily routine.

I've been using them consistently and really appreciate how practical they are. The packaging is also convenient for carrying them when I'm traveling or away from home.
reviews.zh:
我好鍾意呢款穀胱甘肽薄片！好方便、好易用，特別係同傳統嘅片劑或者膠囊比較嘅話。佢好快溶解，味道好好，令我好容易融入每日護理。

我一直都有持續使用，真係好欣賞佢好實用。包裝都好方便攜帶，我外出旅行或者離開屋企嗰陣都好好用。

reviews.text: This Vitamin Village Liposome Glutathione Ever Film is very good! The film technology makes it super easy and convenient to take every day. I love the high quality of the liposomal glutathione, and it absorbs so much better than regular supplements. It has helped brighten my skin and overall complexion. I am very satisfied with the results and will definitely repurchase it!
reviews.zh: 呢款 Vitamin Village Liposome Glutathione Ever Film 好好！薄膜技術令每日食用都超級容易、方便。我好鍾意脂質體穀胱甘肽嘅高質素，佢嘅吸收比一般補充劑好得多。佢幫我提亮咗皮膚同整體膚色。我對效果好滿意，一定會回購！

reviews.text: The first time i took one it tasted horrible in my opinion. I almost threw it in the trash. But i decided to give it a chance and you truly get used to the taste. Second time it was perfectly tolerable and now after almost a month i actually like the taste. I have felt very good taking this and my skin is in great shape so i do recommend it. Just be prepared that first time it might be horrible but now all i taste is sweet citrus.
reviews.zh: 第一次食嗰陣，我覺得味道好難食，我差啲就將佢扔咗。不過我決定俾佢一次機會，你真係會慢慢習慣個味道。第二次就已經可以接受，而家差唔多一個月，我反而鍾意個味道。食咗呢款之後，我感覺好好，皮膚狀態都好好，所以我推薦。只係要準備好，第一次可能會好難食，但而家我食到嘅只係甜甜嘅柑橘味。

reviews.text: I was taking the powder glutathione supplements and saw this so I was very curious to try. I can’t really comment on the results yet but experience wise it’s not as bad as many people say. The taste takes a bit of getting used to but it’s not terrible. Slightly bitter (think lemon with a bit of the bitterness from the peel) Ot dissolves quickly so it didn’t bother me much and it’s very convenient to use so I actually look forward to taking the supplements everyday. it’s also very convenient to just throw in your bag and take on the go. Hoping for good results from this!
reviews.zh: 我一直食緊粉狀嘅穀胱甘肽補充劑，見到呢款之後好想試。效果方面我而家仲未可以講得清楚，但就食用體驗嚟講，冇好多人話咁差。味道要慢慢習慣，但係都唔算難食。有少少苦（好似檸檬加埋果皮嗰種苦味）。佢溶得好快，所以唔會令我好困擾，而且好方便，所以我每日都好期待食。放入袋入面外出食都好方便。希望呢款會有好效果！

reviews.text: The Vitamin Village Glutathione Ever Film is one of the most convenient and effective beauty supplements I’ve tried. I really appreciate the film-type format because it dissolves quickly on the tongue, making it easy to take anytime without water. The taste is mild and pleasant, which is a big plus compared to traditional capsules or tablets. After using it consistently, I noticed my skin gradually looking brighter, clearer, and more even-toned. I also felt an overall glow that made my complexion appear healthier and more refreshed. What I love most is how simple it is to incorporate into a daily routine, especially for people with busy schedules. It feels gentle on the body and gives visible results over time, making it a great option for anyone looking to support skin radiance and overall wellness from within
reviews.zh: Vitamin Village Glutathione Ever Film 係我試過最方便、最有效嘅美容補充劑之一。我好欣賞薄膜形式，因為佢喺舌頭上好快溶解，唔使用水，隨時都可以食。同傳統膠囊或者片劑比較，味道溫和、舒服，係一大優點。持續使用之後，我留意到皮膚慢慢變得更亮、更清透、膚色更均勻。我亦都感到整體有種光澤感，令膚色睇落更健康、更有精神。我最鍾意嘅係，佢好容易融入日常，特別係對於日程好忙嘅人。佢對身體溫和，隨住時間會有可見效果，對於想由內而外支持皮膚光采同整體健康嘅人嚟講，係一個好好嘅選擇。
